description: Run one repo against several devices and return the best candidate per device (verdict, quant, decode band, max context, launch command), sorted best first. Use for 'which of my machines should run X' or 'is a 4090 or an M4 Max better for X'. hardware: comma-separated list of presets / free text / custom specs, e.g. 'rtx3090, unified=1,ram=96,bw=256' is two devices; ';' also separates devices (max 8).
name: compare_hardware
title: Compare one model across devices
